title: Apply for a restricted riding instructor licence
summary: This page provides information and steps for applying for a restricted riding instructor licence, which allows you to teach licensed riders.
intro:
A restricted riding instructor licence allows you to instruct riders who are already licensed – such as defensive rider training for police and ambulance officers.

You are not licensed to teach learner riders.

Note: You can submit your initial application online or at a Service NSW Centre and you have 6 months to meet all the requirements.
who_can_apply: Hold a current full (unrestricted) Australian rider licence (Class R).
Have held the unrestricted licence for a minimum of 3 of the last 4 years.
Be a fit and proper person.
Have a safe riding record (parking offences excluded).
Hold a TAE or Diploma in Education (or equivalent higher qualification).
what_you_need: A commercial medical assessment (no more than 6 months prior).
Successful completion of the rider instructor knowledge test (90 questions in English, without interpreter assistance).
Payment of the 5-year non-refundable licence fee at a service centre.
A secondary proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate rider licence).
If you haven't held a NSW rider licence for more than 5 years, a full riding record/history from the authority in the state or country where you previously held your rider licence.
A digital photo of yourself, or 2 passport size photos (if applying at a service centre).
A copy of completion of the following modules from Certificate IV in Training and Assessment:
A copy of your TAE or Diploma in Education or equivalent higher qualification (as approved by Transport for NSW (TfNSW)).
Proof of passing a TfNSW assessment on the Driving Instructor Act and Regulation (including signing a declaration).
The PDF form: 'Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992' (if applying at a service centre).

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Apply online' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your application once you've started.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.
Download and complete the Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992 – PDF.Note: Do not sign it – your signature must be witnessed at the service centre.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

faqs.q: Who can I teach with a restricted riding instructor licence?
faqs.a: A restricted riding instructor licence allows you to instruct riders who are already licensed, such as for defensive rider training for police and ambulance officers. You cannot teach learner riders.

faqs.q: How long do I have to meet the requirements after applying?
faqs.a: You have 6 months to meet all the requirements after submitting your initial application.

faqs.q: What is required if I previously held a licence outside of NSW?
faqs.a: If you haven't held a NSW rider licence for more than 5 years, you must provide a full riding record/history from the authority in the state or country where you previously held your rider licence.
